cost: Token FSA linear in characters; postprocessing can be quadratic. Dictionary probing needs valid empty slots; fingerprint linear once. TnT training NT^3 plus counts, Viterbi n*K^3 time and n*K^2 storage. Perceptron beam roughly n*b*(features+NT log NT)+n*b^2. Lexgen retained rows and sorted lemma sets U log U; two sequential file writes. chrF six ngram orders expected linear hashing; LCS A*B time/B live space. No benchmark or speed claim.
description: Input characters → tok FSA/splits/merge → forms; tag/PTagger map forms to PTB classes. Morph maps form/tag to lemma and inflects with optional tree_feats agreement; encode retains Raw when inflection/case cannot reproduce form. gram codecs/feature bits connect parsed annotations to udreg predicates. hash numeric/string keys feed lexical/tagger tables; dict probes resolve generated blob entries. lexgen converts synthetic UD+AGID to append-position lemma heap and source-flagged forms, which build.rs compiles into dict (build stage not exercised by runtime temp-file test). text detok consumes one-based order and spacing; chrF/LCS observe lossy output summaries.
forward: Input characters → tok FSA/splits/merge → forms; tag/PTagger map forms to PTB classes. Morph maps form/tag to lemma and inflects with optional tree_feats agreement; encode retains Raw when inflection/case cannot reproduce form. gram codecs/feature bits connect parsed annotations to udreg predicates. hash numeric/string keys feed lexical/tagger tables; dict probes resolve generated blob entries. lexgen converts synthetic UD+AGID to append-position lemma heap and source-flagged forms, which build.rs compiles into dict (build stage not exercised by runtime temp-file test). text detok consumes one-based order and spacing; chrF/LCS observe lossy output summaries.

Tag and ptag call dict/hash/gram; ptag uses TnT prior only unknown words. Morph's UD/AGID/rule priority interacts with lexgen src flags and record order: changing a/r/u alters preferred analyses. tok spacing bits are not exact whitespace; consumers cannot infer original byte offsets from detokenize. text order is 1-based while array positions and dictionary indexes are 0-based. udreg validates selected enum features, so upstream Feats::parse unknown-dropping cannot become a complete annotation gate. Existing conllu callers supply Sentence/Token to learning/generation.

derive (a form the dictionary lacks → known stem + affixes) feeds morph::known_form, the lemmatizer and the ptag/tag unknown-word hints; tagrule forces IN on «so» of purpose through annotate::tags (2026-11-04).
inverse: Composition excludes exact raw-whitespace recovery, unknown-feature validation after lossy parse, and transactional two-file generation. Hash equality cannot establish lexical identity; dict must compare bytes. Beam output cannot be claimed a global Viterbi optimum.

Compatible antecedents for output tags include all lexical/model states attaining chosen score/order; they are many-valued. Morph codec restores exact original form via case/Raw witness, but lemmas alone do not invert forms. Tokenized rendering has arbitrary whitespace antecedents. TSV artifacts reconstruct IDs only with old-heap/order provenance.
limitations: Partial models and finite fixtures, not universal proof.

state: On valid generated dictionary layout and supported trained candidate sets, categorical outputs follow explicit source ordering. Morph decode(encode(form,tag),tag)=form for terminating calls. tok preserves form characters except NUL and normalizes whitespace; text detok preserves given ordered form strings with spacing policy. Dictionary IDs stable only across append-preserving generation; fingerprint binds loaded persisted model to blob. No blanket determinism claim for external environment-sensitive training.
